verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for Unity, which runs cloud and AI services such as Assistant, Credits and Build Automation. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents any setting, policy or API for controlling how long data is kept or for deleting it. Community remarks about the engine phoning home do not describe user-facing retention or deletion controls, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
